headline: Best Kindling Pal in Palworld
title: Best Kindling Pal in Palworld | Renjishi | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Kindling Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Renjishi, with level eight Kindling. Renjishi comes from the World Tree, so in the mid game Jormuntide Ignis is the one to get. The best alternative is Jormuntide Ignis, with level seven Kindling. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Kindling at your base? Comment below!
description: The best Kindling Pal in Palworld 1.0 is Renjishi (level 8 Kindling). Alternative: Jormuntide Ignis (level 7 Kindling). Condensing to 4 stars raises every work suitability by 1.
